Declare @cldrEventId uniqueidentifier Select @cldrEventId = CLDREventId from PFM_CLDR_Event_P(nolock) where EventTypeCode = and ClientEventId= if(@cldrEventId is not null) Begin Declare @CLDREventRecepientId uniqueidentifier Select @CLDREventRecepientId = CLDREventRecepientId from PFM_CLDR_Event_Recipient_P where userid= and CLDREventId =@cldrEventId and UnsubscribedDate is null if(@CLDREventRecepientId is null) Begin insert into PFM_CLDR_Event_Recipient_P (CLDREventRecepientId, userId, RequiredFlag, CreatorId, CreatedDate, LastUpdateId, LastUpdateDate, CLDREventId) values (newid(),,,,GetDate(),,getDate(),@cldrEventId)
